rows.en: If Lord Creation King says that Birugenia's power is needed to eliminate the Kamen Rider… then it can't be helped, can it?

…!?

Apfaron… You wouldn't have been putting ideas into Lord Creation King's head, would you? Meddling where you're not needed…

Not at all…

This is Lord Creation King's own idea! Now… break the seal!

Hmph, you untrustworthy wretch…

Very well, I'll break the seal!
Whoa!?

My demon sword hasn't rusted, at least…

Shut up in such a cramped place for 30,000 years, my body has gotten rather sluggish, Archpriests…

Back then… if I hadn't angered Lord Creation King and been shut away in this coffin… none of you would still be alive, would you?
You bastard…

Ha ha ha ha ha! Just a joke…

I heard everything from inside the coffin. I'll go defeat this Kamen Rider BLACK for you.
(Heh heh heh… So this is Swordsaint Birugenia? Every bit the man the rumors say. This is getting interesting.)

Welco…

…Oh, Oyassan! That's not fair… You promised I'd only mind the shop until noon.

Oh, sorry, sorry. I figured this Great Treasure Exhibition would be all name and nothing else…

but it was actually something else… I got completely absorbed.
But it really was beautiful…
Huh? Oh, so [HERO4] and the others were with you?
Yeah… But I never thought we'd be kept waiting for 2 hours in front of that "sword" and "shield".
A sword and shield?

That's right…

They're said to be a king's sword and shield, and on the shield's decoration, the apple is made of ruby and the snake is made of diamond! Huge rubies and diamonds, too…

Oh, that reminds me… I think there's a photo in this pamphlet…
(…!? This… looks just like it!)
Judging by the size, that ruby must be worth hundreds of millions, huh?
Ah, Kotaro! Even if you go now, the museum will be closed…
Haaah… That was sooo pretty…

Yeah… She kept nagging that we couldn't buy anything anyway, so we should at least look…

But man… I never thought we'd be kept waiting for 2 hours in front of that "sword" and "shield"!

That's right…

They're supposedly a king's sword and shield, and on the shield's decoration, the apple is made of ruby and the snake is made of diamond. Super huge rubies and diamonds, too…

Oh, I know… I got a pamphlet! Maybe there's a photo in here…
Judging by the size, that ruby must be worth hundreds of millions, right?
Huh… Kotaro, where are you going? Even if you go now, the museum's closed.
The design on the sword and shield resembled the mark on Kamen Rider BLACK's chest… Sensing Gorgom's hand in it, Kotaro Minami had rushed out of Amigo!
The Great Treasure Exhibition… This is the place?
(…So he's taken the bait, Kamen Rider BLACK!)
Kishaaaah!

Hm…!?

You're the Rhino Monster!?
Whoa…
Whoa…

…!?

Who are you?

…!?

Who are you?

I am Gorgom's Swordsaint Birugenia, sent from hell to eliminate you!

I learned all of your moves just now, from your fight with the Rhino Monster!
What!?
I'll send you crashing into the depths of hell!
He's strong… And my attacks don't seem to be having any effect. Is he invincible?
He's strong… And my attacks don't seem to be having any effect. Is he invincible?
What's wrong, Kamen Rider!? Is that all the power you have?
Kotaro!
…!? Reinforcements?
Now!
Now! Battle Hopper!
I'm heading back to Amigo for now!
I'm heading back to Amigo for now!
Hmph, he got away… The Kamen Rider doesn't seem to live up to the rumors.
Kotaro's in danger! Let's take him and get back to Amigo!
He's in danger… Let's take Kotaro and get back to Amigo!
Even if it was to defeat the Kamen Rider, how dare you use my beloved Rhino Monster as a shield!?
The difference in strength between it and the Kamen Rider was obvious! If it was going to be beaten anyway, it's only natural for it to be a sacrificial pawn, wouldn't you say?

Well, never mind…

But after cornering the Kamen Rider that far, why did you let him get away?

I've thoroughly analyzed his fighting power. I can eliminate him whenever I like!

More to the point, to think that someone with that little power was a candidate to be the next Creation King… Gorgom has really fallen low.
You… Are you mocking us!?

No… I'm lamenting my own fate.

Born on the same "day of a solar eclipse", yet just because I was born 30,000 years too early, I'm not qualified to be a Century King…
If you have time for idle chatter, go defeat the Kamen Rider!
Picking fights recklessly won't beat him! You have to use your head…
Wh-why, you!!

A short temper only hurts yourself, Archpriest Baraom…

Oh well… I'll smoke out the Kamen Rider and execute him!

Are you really all right, Kotaro…

If it's a hospital that can treat cyborgs… it'd be the TDF hospital! Why don't you go get yourself looked at?
I'm fine. If I just rest a little…

Big trouble, Kotaro!!

Right in town, a man holding that king's sword that was stolen from the museum is rampaging, yelling for Kamen Rider BLACK to be brought to him!
What!?

Hey, Kotaro! Where are you going? Your injuries haven't healed yet!

Kotaro, don't do anything reckless! Kotarooo!! Argh… he's gone and run off! Honestly, what a handful…
Kyaaah! Heeelp!!
Hey, what are you doing!?
Bring me Kamen Rider BLAAACK!
Stop this foolishness!

No doubt about it… That sword is Birugenia's.

Even so… what terrifying eyes he has.
I can't wait any longer! I'm taking this woman's life!!
Stop iiit!
Wait! Stop!

…………

Huh!? What's going on? How did this happen???
Don't talk nonsense! You were holding this sword and…

Wh-what's wrong? Officer!! Get a grip!

Waah!? …S-somebody help meee!!
Heh heh heh… Cut down the man in the blue jacket in front of you!
Yaaaah!

U08427: 大神官様 (plural audience) rendered "Archpriests".
U08439/U08444: 嬉の値/嬉 read as 億 ("worth hundreds of millions").
U08480: 改造人間 rendered "cyborgs"; TDF付属病院 "the TDF hospital".
U08489: 恐ろしい目 refers to the possessed man ("he").
U08497: 青のブルゾン rendered "blue jacket".
